$comment: What a Kotlin type or string literal, as the source writes it, tells of a value joined into HTML: the fact of a declared type (null when nothing is known), whether a type is a collection of Streamlord's markup, whether a literal's content opens with a tag, and the fact of what an editor answers of a value: the type it resolved, written with every class by its qualified name, whether it is a constant, and what the editor read of it. The IntelliJ plugin reads types and literals with the same functions. Read by ValueTypesTest.kt.
